questions.text: Jensen Huang ceases to be Nvidia's chief executive within 30 days
questions.prior_rationale: Judgment value. Large-company chief executives turn over at roughly one in ten per year and founders less often; about 6 percent a year is about 0.5 percent per 30 days. Not measured in this project.

date_labels.2026-10-28: day before the first report of the relationship
date_labels.2026-11-06: day before the affair itself was reported

questions.text: Who is Nvidia's next permanent chief executive, if one is named by 31 December 2027?

labels.external_chip: Outside hire who runs or ran a chip company

questions.prior_rationale: Judgment values: interim chiefs are confirmed in a minority of cases, and boards split roughly evenly between insiders and outsiders after a forced exit. Not measured in this project.

questions.text: Nvidia names a permanent chief executive by 30 June 2027
questions.prior_rationale: Judgment value: searches after an abrupt exit usually take several months.

questions.text: Jensen Huang appears before House committees, in open or closed session, by 26 November 2026
questions.prior_rationale: Judgment value: agreed voluntary appearances often slip past the first target date.

questions.text: Jensen Huang holds a formal Nvidia role (employee, director or named adviser) on 31 December 2027
questions.prior_rationale: Judgment value: leaders who resign during an investigation rarely hold a formal role again within about a year.

questions.text: Jensen Huang is criminally charged in the United States by 31 December 2027
questions.prior_rationale: Judgment value: executives in corporate scandals are seldom charged, and rarely within about a year. A legal-exposure question, not an allegation.
